title: Cosmetology Salon Interior Design 54 m² | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: 54 m² cosmetology salon: design project, 3D visualisation, custom furniture and turnkey renovation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN, Bratislava and Vienna.

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed the interior design project for the 54 m² ABC Cosmetology salon. The project was created within the Express interior design package, with a focus on functional space planning, client comfort and an efficient working environment for specialists.

The salon layout was designed around the specific requirements of cosmetology procedures and everyday workflows. The project includes a reception and waiting area, cosmetology treatment rooms and a restroom. Functional zoning allows the available floor area to be used efficiently while providing convenient circulation for clients and staff.

Particular attention was given to ergonomics, lighting, the organization of treatment areas and the creation of a contemporary professional atmosphere. The interior combines aesthetic solutions with the practical requirements of cosmetology and beauty spaces.

The project includes photorealistic 3D visualizations and technical documentation, providing a clear representation of the interior concept and the information required for implementing the proposed design solutions.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides interior design for cosmetology salons, aesthetic medicine clinics, beauty salons and other commercial spaces in Bratislava and Vienna. We develop individual projects based on the specific requirements of each business, available floor area, functionality and the client’s preferences.
